name: FA_BOOK_TRANSFER_DISTS
description: This table contains asset distribution source and destination data for transfer between book transactions.

columns.name: BOOK_TRANSFER_DIST_ID
columns.description: Distribution mapping identifier for transfer between books transactions.

columns.name: TRX_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction reference which links transactions involving multiple assets.

columns.name: SRC_BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique source book identification name.

columns.name: SRC_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Source asset number identifier.

columns.name: SRC_TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Source asset transaction identifier.

columns.name: DEST_BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique destination book identification name.

columns.name: DEST_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Destination asset number identifier.

columns.name: DEST_TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Destination asset transaction identifier.

columns.name: SRC_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Source asset distribution identifier.

columns.name: SRC_DIST_CCID
columns.description: Source asset account code combination identifier for the depreciation expense account.

columns.name: DEST_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Destination asset distribution identifier.

columns.name: DEST_DIST_CCID
columns.description: Destination asset account code combination identifier for the depreciation expense account.

columns.name: DEST_MASSADD_DIST_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Mass addition distribution identification number.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: UNITS
columns.description: Number of units moved between the corresponding source and destination assignments.
